candidate_relations.reason: Marrow dysplasia with 10–15% blasts and shared ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 variants supports an evolving myeloid neoplasm but omits LCH.
BRAF-V600E was proven in the skin lesion, yet this broad label does not identify cutaneous LCH or concurrent AML.
The dermal cells were uniformly langerin-positive and myeloperoxidase-negative rather than myeloid sarcoma cells.
Langerin-positive BRAF-V600E dermal histiocytes establish LCH, but this candidate omits cutaneous scope and evolving AML.
A tiny papule with no reported pleomorphism or destructive high-grade behavior does not support Langerhans cell sarcoma.
Uniform CD207 positivity and BRAF-V600E favor LCH rather than Rosai-Dorfman disease.
The infiltrate was monocytoid and langerin-positive, with no mast-cell markers or systemic mastocytosis findings.
Biopsy described histiocytic cells without melanocytic morphology or lineage markers despite the shared BRAF mutation.
Identical ASXL1 variation links skin and marrow clones but does not specify either LCH phenotype or AML evolution.
BRAF-V600E is a demonstrated mutation in the lesion, not the full clinicopathologic diagnosis.
The BRAF-positive papule is neoplastic, but lineage-defining langerin and the marrow process are omitted.
Marrow blasts and shared pathogenic variants support evolving AML, while the cutaneous LCH half of the composite is missing.
Skin and marrow shared mutations, but CD207 positivity with absent myeloperoxidase identifies histiocytic differentiation rather than myelodysplastic infiltration.
The mutation-defined wording is compatible with the BRAF-positive lesion but lacks its Langerhans phenotype and AML context.
No lymphoid immunophenotype was reported in the diffuse langerin-positive monocytoid infiltrate.
Shared IDH2 variation supports clonal relatedness to marrow disease without naming the two concurrent diagnostic entities.

case_quality_flags: The marrow blast percentage of 10–15% is below the usual morphologic AML threshold, so the 'evolving AML' component depends on longitudinal context not shown here.
